list.name: asset
list.label: Asset
list.query:
SELECT asset
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND asset IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

list.definition:

FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND asset IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Listed instruments
panels.description: Instruments of the selected assets and types on the latest day in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(*) AS instruments
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: New listings in range
panels.description: Instruments on the latest day whose trading started within the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, trading_start_date
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(*) AS new_listings
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND $__timeFilter(trading_start_date::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Expiring in next 30 days
panels.description: Instruments on the latest day expiring within 30 days of it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, expiration_date
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(*) AS expiring
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND expiration_date BETWEEN trad_dt AND trad_dt + INTERVAL 30 DAY

panels.title: Latest file day
panels.description: Most recent instruments file in the range for the selected assets.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(trad_dt), '%Y-%m-%d') AS latest
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Listed instruments per asset
panels.description: Daily number of registered instruments per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*) AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Growth since start of range
panels.description: Instrument count relative to each asset's first day in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*) AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT time, asset, instruments / first_value(instruments) OVER (PARTITION BY asset ORDER BY time) - 1 AS growth
FROM daily
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Daily net change
panels.description: Instrument count vs the previous file day, per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*) AS instruments
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  GROUP BY ALL
),
changes AS (
  SELECT time, asset, instruments - lag(instruments) OVER (PARTITION BY asset ORDER BY time) AS change
  FROM daily
)
SELECT time, asset, change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Added instruments per day
panels.description: Tickers present on the day but not on the previous file day, per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt, asset, coalesce(ticker, instrument_id::VARCHAR) AS ticker
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
days AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM d)
),
assets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT asset FROM d
),
changes AS (
  SELECT days.trad_dt, c.asset, count(*) AS n
  FROM days
  JOIN d c ON c.trad_dt = days.trad_dt
  ANTI JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = days.prev AND p.asset = c.asset AND p.ticker = c.ticker
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, assets.asset, coalesce(changes.n, 0) AS added
FROM days
CROSS JOIN assets
LEFT JOIN changes ON changes.trad_dt = days.trad_dt AND changes.asset = assets.asset
WHERE days.prev IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Removed instruments per day
panels.description: Tickers present on the previous file day but gone on the day (mostly expirations), per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt, asset, coalesce(ticker, instrument_id::VARCHAR) AS ticker
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
days AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM d)
),
assets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT asset FROM d
),
changes AS (
  SELECT days.trad_dt, p.asset, count(*) AS n
  FROM days
  JOIN d p ON p.trad_dt = days.prev
  ANTI JOIN d c ON c.trad_dt = days.trad_dt AND c.asset = p.asset AND c.ticker = p.ticker
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, assets.asset, coalesce(changes.n, 0) AS removed
FROM days
CROSS JOIN assets
LEFT JOIN changes ON changes.trad_dt = days.trad_dt AND changes.asset = assets.asset
WHERE days.prev IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(days.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Underlying last price
panels.description: Last price of each asset's main underlying as published in the file (types with equity underlyings, e.g. options).

targets.rawSql:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, asset, underlying_instrument_id AS und, count(*) AS n
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND underlying_instrument_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL
),
p AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, instrument_id, ticker, last_price
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE last_price IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
j AS (
  SELECT o.trad_dt, o.asset, p.ticker, p.last_price::DOUBLE AS price, o.n
  FROM o
  JOIN p ON p.trad_dt = o.trad_dt AND p.instrument_id = o.und
),
pick AS (
  SELECT asset, arg_max(ticker, total) AS underlying
  FROM (SELECT asset, ticker, sum(n) AS total FROM j GROUP BY ALL)
  GROUP BY asset
),
daily AS (
  SELECT j.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, j.asset, any_value(j.price) AS price
  FROM j
  JOIN pick ON pick.asset = j.asset AND pick.underlying = j.ticker
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT time, asset, price
FROM daily
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Underlying return since start of range
panels.description: Underlying last price relative to its first value in the range, per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, asset, underlying_instrument_id AS und, count(*) AS n
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND underlying_instrument_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL
),
p AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, instrument_id, ticker, last_price
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE last_price IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
j AS (
  SELECT o.trad_dt, o.asset, p.ticker, p.last_price::DOUBLE AS price, o.n
  FROM o
  JOIN p ON p.trad_dt = o.trad_dt AND p.instrument_id = o.und
),
pick AS (
  SELECT asset, arg_max(ticker, total) AS underlying
  FROM (SELECT asset, ticker, sum(n) AS total FROM j GROUP BY ALL)
  GROUP BY asset
),
daily AS (
  SELECT j.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, j.asset, any_value(j.price) AS price
  FROM j
  JOIN pick ON pick.asset = j.asset AND pick.underlying = j.ticker
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT time, asset, price / nullif(first_value(price) OVER (PARTITION BY asset ORDER BY time), 0) - 1 AS return
FROM daily
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Instruments per expiration (chain depth)
panels.description: Average listed instruments per future expiration date, per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*) / count(DISTINCT expiration_date) AS per_expiration
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND expiration_date >= trad_dt
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Expiration dates listed
panels.description: Distinct future expiration dates per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(DISTINCT expiration_date) AS expirations
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND expiration_date >= trad_dt
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Near-the-money share (strike within 10%)
panels.description: Share of options with strike within 10% of their underlying's last price, per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, asset, underlying_instrument_id, strike_price::DOUBLE AS strike
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND strike_price IS NOT NULL
),
p AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, instrument_id, last_price::DOUBLE AS price
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE last_price > 0
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT o.trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, o.asset, avg((abs(o.strike / p.price - 1) <= 0.1)::INT) AS near_money
FROM o
JOIN p ON p.trad_dt = o.trad_dt AND p.instrument_id = o.underlying_instrument_id
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Average days to expiration
panels.description: Mean days until expiration of the listed instruments per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, avg(expiration_date - trad_dt) AS days_to_expiration
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND expiration_date >= trad_dt
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Listed instruments, stacked by asset

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*) AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Listed instruments by record type
panels.description: Daily instruments of the selected assets stacked by record type; ignores the type filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, record_type, count(*) AS instruments
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL

panels.title: Selected assets (latest day in range)
panels.description: Counts, expirations, strikes and underlying price per selected asset on the latest day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
l AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
),
p AS (
  SELECT instrument_id, ticker, last_price::DOUBLE AS price
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
    AND last_price IS NOT NULL
),
u AS (
  SELECT l.asset, p.ticker, any_value(p.price) AS price, count(*) AS n
  FROM l
  JOIN p ON p.instrument_id = l.underlying_instrument_id
  GROUP BY ALL
),
up AS (
  SELECT asset, arg_max(ticker, n) AS underlying, arg_max(price, n) AS underlying_price
  FROM u
  GROUP BY asset
)
SELECT
  l.asset,
  up.underlying,
  up.underlying_price,
  count(*) AS instruments,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'CALL') AS calls,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'PUTT') AS puts,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE trading_start_date = trad_dt) AS new_today,
  count(DISTINCT expiration_date) FILTER (WHERE expiration_date >= trad_dt) AS expirations,
  strftime(min(expiration_date) FILTER (WHERE expiration_date >= trad_dt), '%Y-%m-%d') AS next_expiration,
  min(strike_price)::DOUBLE AS min_strike,
  max(strike_price)::DOUBLE AS max_strike
FROM l
LEFT JOIN up ON up.asset = l.asset
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY instruments DESC

panels.title: Most listed assets (latest day in range)
panels.description: Top 20 assets by instruments on the latest day in the selected types; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, asset, count(*) AS n
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND asset IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
),
b AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_day, max(trad_dt) AS last_day FROM c
),
l AS (
  SELECT
    asset,
    count(*) AS instruments,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'CALL') AS calls,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'PUTT') AS puts,
    count(DISTINCT expiration_date) FILTER (WHERE expiration_date >= trad_dt) AS expirations
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND trad_dt = (SELECT last_day FROM b)
  GROUP BY asset
)
SELECT l.*, l.instruments - coalesce(c.n, 0) AS change_in_range
FROM l
LEFT JOIN c ON c.asset = l.asset AND c.trad_dt = (SELECT first_day FROM b)
WHERE l.asset IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY instruments DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Biggest growers (range)
panels.description: Top 15 assets by net instruments added from the first to the last day in the range; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, asset, count(*) AS n
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND asset IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
),
b AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_day, max(trad_dt) AS last_day FROM c
),
r AS (
  SELECT
    asset,
    coalesce(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT first_day FROM b)), 0)::BIGINT AS first_count,
    coalesce(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT last_day FROM b)), 0)::BIGINT AS last_count
  FROM c
  GROUP BY asset
)
SELECT asset, first_count, last_count, last_count - first_count AS change
FROM r
ORDER BY change DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Biggest shrinkers (range)
panels.description: Top 15 assets by net instruments removed from the first to the last day in the range; ignores the asset filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, asset, count(*) AS n
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND asset IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY ALL
),
b AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_day, max(trad_dt) AS last_day FROM c
),
r AS (
  SELECT
    asset,
    coalesce(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT first_day FROM b)), 0)::BIGINT AS first_count,
    coalesce(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT last_day FROM b)), 0)::BIGINT AS last_count
  FROM c
  GROUP BY asset
)
SELECT asset, first_count, last_count, last_count - first_count AS change
FROM r
ORDER BY change ASC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Upcoming expirations, next 30 days (latest day in range)
panels.description: Instruments of the selected assets expiring within 30 days, by date and asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  strftime(expiration_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expiration_date,
  asset,
  record_type,
  count(*) AS instruments,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'CALL') AS calls,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'PUTT') AS puts,
  min(strike_price)::DOUBLE AS min_strike,
  max(strike_price)::DOUBLE AS max_strike
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND expiration_date BETWEEN trad_dt AND trad_dt + INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY expiration_date, instruments DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: New listings in range (latest day in range)
panels.description: Instruments of the selected assets whose trading started within the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  strftime(trading_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS trading_start,
  ticker,
  asset,
  record_type,
  strftime(expiration_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expiration,
  option_type,
  strike_price::DOUBLE AS strike
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND $__timeFilter(trading_start_date::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY trading_start_date DESC, ticker
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Instrument lookup (latest day in range)
panels.description: Registry details of the selected assets' instruments on the latest day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  ticker,
  record_type,
  security_category,
  instrument_id,
  isin,
  asset,
  description,
  corporate_name,
  specification_code,
  segment,
  cfi_code,
  currency,
  strftime(expiration_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expiration_date,
  option_type,
  option_style,
  strike_price::DOUBLE AS strike_price,
  underlying_instrument_id,
  contract_multiplier::DOUBLE AS contract_multiplier,
  round_lot,
  last_price::DOUBLE AS last_price,
  strftime(trading_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS trading_start_date,
  strftime(trading_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS trading_end_date
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY asset, expiration_date NULLS FIRST, ticker
LIMIT 2000

panels.title: $asset instruments by expiration (latest day)
panels.description: Calls, puts and other instruments per upcoming expiration date on the latest day, one panel per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, expiration_date, option_type
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset = $asset
    AND record_type IN ($record_type)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
  strftime(expiration_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expiration,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'CALL') AS "Calls",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'PUTT') AS "Puts",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type IS NULL) AS "Other"
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
  AND expiration_date >= trad_dt
GROUP BY expiration_date
ORDER BY expiration_date
LIMIT 24

panels.title: $asset calls / puts / other
panels.description: Daily listed calls, puts and other instruments, stacked so the top edge is the total, one panel per selected asset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'CALL') AS "Calls",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type = 'PUTT') AS "Puts",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE option_type IS NULL) AS "Other"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset = $asset
  AND record_type IN ($record_type)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
